settings_sp_auth_desc: Na zaɓi. Wasu makasudin MediaTek sun ƙi yin walƙiya har sai an ba SP Flash Tool fayil ɗin tantancewa (.auth); ƙara naku anan idan na'urar tana buƙatar ɗaya.

{terminal_name} will now open running {method}.

sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Shigar ta SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI yanzu zai buɗe tare da shigar da firmware ɗin ku.

• A cikin SP Flash Tool, zaɓi "Zazzagewa" daga akwatin zazzagewa.
• Danna maɓallin "Download".
• Tabbatar cewa an kashe {device} kuma an cire haɗin.
{hint}
• Haɗa kebul na USB zuwa kwamfutarka bayan danna Zazzagewa.

Danna Ok don ƙaddamar da SP Flash Tool kuma fita Updater CE.

Sakin software na asali wanda ya girmi 3.0.7 ba su dace da raka'a Y1 da aka sayar da Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Yin walƙiya tsohuwar gini akan waɗannan raka'a zai hana su yin booting har sai an sake shigar da sabon sigar.

Sakin Rockbox-Y1 kafin 0.5 bai dace da raka'o'in Y1 da aka sayar ba bayan Maris 2026 tare da Innioasis OS 3.0.7 da aka riga aka shigar.

Shin kun tabbata kuna son nuna tsoffin ginin Rockbox?

sel_offline: Babu jerin jerin kan layi a yanzu. Yi amfani da fayil na gida, ko duba haɗin ku.
sel_no_release: Babu sakin da ke akwai don wannan software

sp_auth_missing_file: Ba a samo fayil ɗin tantancewa ba ({path}); walƙiya ba tare da shi ba.

settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Ajiye app ɗin a cikin mashaya menu bayan rufe taga, don haka har yanzu kuna samun sanarwar sabunta firmware da app da mai kunnawa. A kashe: rufe taga yana barin app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Ajiye ƙa'idar a cikin tire na tsarin bayan taga ta rufe, don haka har yanzu kuna samun sanarwar sabunta firmware da app da mai kunnawa. A kashe: rufe taga yana barin app.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Ɓoye ƙasidar al'umma ta kan layi kuma shigar da software daga fayilolin gida kawai.

sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Da fatan za a cire haɗin USB, kunna kuma kunna cikin Rockbox sau ɗaya (don haka yana fara babban fayil ɗin tsarin .rockbox na ciki), sannan sake haɗa USB kuma zaɓi 'Yanayin Ajiya na USB'.

Lokacin da aka haɗa, danna Ci gaba don zaɓar kowane babban fayil akan mai kunna ku.

sel_only_local_generic: Zaɓi fakitin firmware na gida (.zip, .rar) ko babban fayil mai ɗauke da fayil ɗin watsawa don shigarwar layi, yana aiki tare da na'urorin MediaTek na gabaɗaya.

single_instance_focus_failed: Kwafin da ke gudana bai amsa buƙatar nuna taga ta ba. Yana iya zama mai aiki ko rataye. Tilasta barin shi zai katse duk wani abu da yake sakawa.
single_instance_force_failed: An kasa ƙare kwafin mai gudana. Bar shi da kanka, sa'an nan kuma fara sabuntawa kuma.
single_instance_busy_body: Kwafin da ke gudana shine shigar da software ko magana da mai kunnawa, don haka ƙare shi yanzu zai katse hakan. Wannan ƙaddamarwa zai rufe; yi amfani da taga data kasance ko gunkin menu nasa lokacin da shigarwa ya ƙare.

support_story_1_headline: Lokacin da masana'antun suka ci gaba, al'umma suna haɓaka.
support_story_1_lead: Kare na'urarka daga tarko na kayan aikin shiru da karyewar bita.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis a kai a kai yana fitar da sabbin firmwares don 'yan wasa kamar Y1 (yana nufin bita-da-kullin allon allo kamar 6.0, 7.0, da 8.0) waɗanda ke karya tsofaffin na'urori cikin shiru. Mafi muni, gidan yanar gizon su yana ba da gargaɗin sifili da damar sifili zuwa na'urorin firmware na baya don murmurewa daga yanayin bulo. Updater CE da aikin Firmware na Community sun tattara guntu-guntu: muna adana kowane kayan gado na ROM, tabbatar da sake fasalin kayan aikinku ta atomatik, kuma kiyaye ɗan wasan ku yana gudana lafiya.
support_story_1_item_1: Ceto Ƴan wasan Karyayye: Binciken aminci yana tabbatar da sabbin abubuwan sabuntawa ba su taɓa tubalin tsofaffin kayan aikin ba.
support_story_1_item_2: Hannun jari na ROMs: Cikakken tarin kayan aikin masana'anta na asali Innioasis an goge.
support_story_1_item_3: Ƙasar Cross-Platform: Cikakken kayan aikin walƙiya don macOS, Linux, da Windows iri ɗaya.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Gano allo ta atomatik don haka koyaushe kuna samun fakitin da ya dace.
support_story_2_headline: Babu karya Google Drives. Babu zato-aiki. Kawai aiki firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Babban sauri, ingantattun ababen more rayuwa na al'umma da za ku iya dogaro da su.
support_story_2_body: Bibiyar software na Innioasis na hukuma yawanci yana nufin zazzage taron don hanyoyin haɗin Google Drive da suka ƙare, matattun bayanan girgije na Baidu, da fayilolin zip na sirri ba tare da kayan aikin walƙiya ba. Mun gina ingantaccen hanyar zazzagewa mai zaman kanta tare da ingantaccen amincin SHA-256, sabunta sanarwar, da shigarwar mataki-mataki. Gudunmawar ku kai tsaye tana kiyaye abubuwan zazzagewa da ɗaukar nauyi waɗanda ke ba da damar hakan awanni 24 a rana, kwanaki 365 a shekara.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN Mai Saurin Kai tsaye: Mai sauri, zazzagewar kai tsaye ba tare da iyakoki na saukewa ko matattun hanyoyin haɗin yanar gizo ba.
support_story_2_item_2: Sabunta Fadakarwa: Samun faɗakarwa lokacin da sabbin fitowar al'umma ko gyare-gyare suka ragu.
support_story_2_item_3: Shirye-shiryen Matakai na Mataki-mataki: Tsare-tsare na gani yana tafiya da ku ta kowane latsa maɓallin.
support_story_2_item_4: Al'ummar Harsuna da yawa: An keɓance cikakke cikin Ingilishi, Sinanci, Jamusanci, Sifen, Faransanci & Jafananci.
support_story_3_headline: Buɗe cikakken damar ɗan wasan ku na Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Kawo Rockbox, tsarin aiki marasa nauyi na al'ada, da 'yancin sauti.
support_story_3_body: Software na masana'anta na hannun jari kawai yana toshe saman abin da kayan aikin Y1 ko Y2 ɗinku zai iya yi. Al'ummarmu sun kawo Rockbox, tsarin aiki na al'ada mara nauyi, sake kunnawa codec audiophile, da jigogi na al'ada zuwa rayuwa. Muna siyan bambance-bambancen kayan aikin jiki daga aljihu don gwadawa, juyar da injiniyanci, da tabbatar da kowane shigarwa. Taimakawa Updater CE kai tsaye yana ba da kuɗin waɗannan rukunin gwajin kuma yana haɓaka haɓaka firmware na al'ada.
support_story_3_item_1: Danna Rockbox Daya: An shigar da sake kunna sauti da jigogi na al'ada a cikin dakika.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware Community: Haɓaka baturi, UI mai tsabta, da tallafin codec na zamani na zamani.
support_story_3_item_3: Lab Lab ɗin Hardware Mai Aiki: Muna gwada kan na'urori na zahiri kafin mu saki kowane gini.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% kyauta, software na farko na sirri ba tare da talla ko sa ido ba.
support_story_4_headline: Taimaka mana muyi abin da Innioasis baya yi.
support_story_4_lead: Kiyaye firmware mai ƙarfi na al'umma yana kiyaye na'urorin ku daga wuraren da ba a cika ba.
support_story_4_body: Lokacin da kamfanin kayan masarufi ya matsa zuwa na'urarsu ta gaba, tsofaffin ƙira suna yin watsi da su. Innioasis yana ba da tallafin Linux, babu bayanan canji na gaskiya, kuma babu hanya mai sauƙi don murmurewa lokacin da shigarwa ya gaza. Updater CE yana wanzu saboda masu sha'awar masu amfani bai kamata su jefar da ingantaccen mai kunna kiɗan ba. 100% na gudummawar al'umma suna tafiya kai tsaye don buɗe wannan kayan aikin ga kowa da kowa.
support_story_4_item_1: Ceto & Cire tubalin: An tabbatar da dawo da aiki koda lokacin da na'urori suka ƙi yin taya.
support_story_4_item_2: Tallafi na Farko na Linux: Cikakken tallafin MediaTek yana walƙiya akan Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Fassarar Canje-canje: Cikakken bayanin kula don ku san ainihin menene canje-canje.
support_story_4_item_4: An Tallafawa Al'umma 100%: Kowane kofi yana buɗewa kuma kyauta ga kowa.

update_install_linux: Zazzage {hint}, sanya shi mai aiwatarwa, sannan ku gudanar da shi, ya maye gurbin sigar da ta gabata.
update_install_generic: Zazzage {hint} daga shafin saki kuma bi umarnin shigarwa na tsarin ku.
update_up_to_date: Kuna da sabuntawa, sigar {version} ita ce sabuwar.
update_check_failed: An kasa bincika sabuntawa a yanzu. Duba haɗin ku kuma sake gwadawa.
settings_drivers_gate_body: Shigar da direbobi na MediaTek na USB mataki ne na lokaci ɗaya, kuma Windows kawai yana ɗaukar su bayan an sake farawa. Har sai an gama duka biyun, ƙa'idar ƙila ba za ta sami ɗan wasan ku ba lokacin da shigarwa ya fara.
settings_drivers_gate_done: Na shigar dasu kuma na sake farawa
settings_reminders_desc: Za mu sanar da ku lokacin da aka fitar da sabon sigar software don mai kunna ku.
settings_enable_y1: Kunna masu tuni na saki don Innioasis Y1
settings_enable_y2: Kunna masu tuni na saki don Innioasis Y2
settings_enable_a5: Kunna masu tuni na saki don Innioasis A5
settings_not_installed: Ba a yi rikodin shigarwa ba tukuna (ajiya ta atomatik bayan walƙiya)
settings_firmware_up_to_date: Duk na'urorin da aka sa ido suna gudanar da sabbin firikwensin firmware!
settings_no_devices_tracked: Ba a yi rikodin shigarwar na'ura ba tukuna. Flash na'urar don kunna sigar bin diddigin.
settings_hide_donations_tip: Kashe don ɓoye ƙididdiga da abubuwan bayar da gudummawa don kyakkyawan kyan gani.
settings_donations_dismiss: Kar a sake nuna min wannan
settings_skip_install_donations: Tsallake abubuwan bayar da gudummawa bayan shigarwa
settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Nuna cikakkun bayanai masu sauƙi ba tare da neman gudummawa ba bayan walƙiya.
settings_cache_desc: Share fakitin firmware da aka zazzage da fitar da fayilolin ROM don yantar da sarari diski. An adana tarihin shigar ku da sabunta abubuwan da za ku tuna.
reminder_dont_remind_device: Kar a tunatar da ni game da sabbin abubuwan da aka fitar na wannan na'urar
reminder_dont_remind_release: Kar a tuna min da wannan sakin
reminder_prompt_install: Kuna so a fara shigar dashi (tare da hanyar da kuka zaɓa: {method})?
reminder_prompt_install_generic: Kuna so a fara shigar dashi?
retry_guidance_intro: Haɗin USB zuwa mai kunna ku ya daina amsawa. Mai kunna ku yana buƙatar sake saitin hannu kafin wani ƙoƙari ya yi aiki.
retry_guidance_step_1: 1. Cire kebul na USB daga mai kunnawa.
retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Danna maɓallin sake saitin da aka ɓoye tare da fil, faifan takarda ko ɗan kunne.
retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Toshe kebul na USB baya, sannan a sake gwadawa.
onboarding_after_add_body: Za mu sanar da ku game da sabuntawa da batutuwan da al'umma suka ruwaito don software akan waɗannan samfuran:
onboarding_after_add_footer:
Sanin irin software na na'urarka yana tabbatar da cewa an aiwatar da shigarwa daidai don duk software da ke cikin app.

Idan kun gama ƙara na'urori, kawai danna Anyi don fara amfani da Updater.
onboarding_body: Faɗa mana wace software kowane ɗan wasa ke gudana, kuma za mu sanar da ku lokacin da sabuntawa suka fita, kiyaye saitunan ku da kuma taimaka idan shigarwa ya yi kuskure. Ƙara ɗan wasan ku yanzu don duk wannan ya fara aiki daga farkon shigarwa.
onboarding_version_hint: Ba tabbata ko wane sigar ba? A kan Software na Asali yana ƙarƙashin Saituna › Game da kan mai kunnawa.
settings_reminders_enable: Faɗa mini game da sabbin abubuwan sabuntawa ga ɗan wasa na
settings_reminders_tracked: Za mu sanar da ku idan akwai sabuntawa zuwa {software} akan {devices}.
settings_reminders_tracked_original: Za mu sanar da ku lokacin da aka fito da sabon sigar software don {model}.
settings_reminders_tracked_named: Za mu sanar da ku lokacin da aka fitar da sabon sigar {software} don {model} naku.
settings_reminders_tracked_multi: Za mu sanar da ku lokacin da aka fitar da sabbin nau'ikan waɗannan.
settings_themes_refresh_failed: An kasa wartsakewa; jigogin da aka adana har yanzu suna nan.
settings_method_group_mediatek: Injin walƙiya don mai sakawa MediaTek
flash_method_note_mtk_mac: Yanayin macOS da aka kwaikwayi: yana gudanar da kwararar Mac akan wannan injin, MTKClient shine kawai baya kuma ana nuna takamaiman takamaiman macOS. Don gwaji kawai; app yana sake farawa don nema.
simulated_mac_body_mediatek: MTKClient ya zama kawai hanyar shigarwa kuma ana nuna takamaiman takamaiman macOS. MediaTek Installer yana buƙatar sake farawa don amfani da wannan.
simulated_mac_body: MTKClient ya zama kawai hanyar shigarwa kuma ana nuna takamaiman takamaiman macOS. Updater CE yana buƙatar sake farawa don amfani da wannan.
sel_instructions_below: Da fatan za a bi umarnin da ke ƙasa don shigar da wannan software akan {lbl}
sel_install_tooltip: Sanya software ɗin da aka zaɓa akan {lbl}
mtk_da_required: Zaɓi Wakilin Zazzagewa kafin fara shigarwa.
sel_type_help_tooltip: Gwada Nau'in Software na System tukuna. Idan motar gungurawa ba ta amsa ba bayan shigarwa, shigar da ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan Nau'in B. Nau'in B sune waɗanda suka zo da nau'ikan firmware a baya fiye da 2.0.
device_type_help_msg:
Gwada Nau'in Software na System tukuna.

Idan motar gungurawa ba ta amsa ba bayan shigarwa, shigar da ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan Nau'in B.

install_power_on_steps_fmt: Don kunna {label} naka, cire kebul ɗin kuma ka riƙe {button}.
sp_gui_prompt_steps_fmt:
• Idan bai riga ya kashe ba, kashe wutar lantarki {label}.
• Idan an haɗa ta da USB, cire haɗin ta da farko.
• A SP Flash Tool, danna Zazzagewa.

Gwada Nau'in Software na System tukuna.

sel_install_tooltip_generic: Shigar da zaɓaɓɓen software na tsarin akan na'urarka
dl_resuming_fmt: Ci gaba da saukewa daga {mb} MB...
linux_engine_staged_desc: MediaTek SP Flash Tool wanda aka tsara tare da dacewa da libpng12.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Danna Sake dubawa ko sake farawa saitin don sauke kunshin.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Dokokin MediaTek suna aiki (/etc/udev/rules.d/). An kunna damar shiga Desktop.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Ba da izini sau ɗaya don app ɗin zai iya sadarwa tare da na'urarka.
linux_perms_ok_msg: An shigar da izini na USB & dokokin udev cikin nasara. An saita ayyuka.
donate_rely_on_you: Taimaka mana da kuɗin tafiyarmu, ba da gudummawa a yau.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Bude MediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: App ɗin ya sake saita gaba ɗaya zuwa abubuwan da ba a so, an share cache, kuma an dawo da tunatarwar baturi.
log_app_reset_defaults: Saitin ƙa'idar gabaɗaya ta sake saitawa zuwa abubuwan da suka dace, an share cache, kuma an dawo da tunatarwar baturi (R).
flash_watch_waiting: Ana jiran ɗan wasan ku ya sake farawa…
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Ci gaba da toshe shi, Rockbox yana farawa kuma za a ƙara jigoginsa ta atomatik.
flash_watch_found: An gano mai kunnawa, yana ƙara jigogi na Rockbox…
flash_watch_timeout: Dan wasan ku bai dawo ba tukuna.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Duba cewa an toshe shi kuma a kunne. Idan ya yi duhu, danna fil a cikin ramin sake saiti kuma ka riƙe maɓallin tsakiya (Y1) ko maɓallin wuta (wasu 'yan wasa) don sake kunna shi. Idan har yanzu ba za ta fara ba, firmware ɗin bai ɗauka ba, shigar da wani.
action_searching: Neman na'urar (a ci gaba da cirewa)...
action_brom_detected: An gano na'urar a yanayin BROM...
action_flash_complete: Filashi ya cika! Cire haɗin USB kuma sake yi.
action_recover_powercycle: Mai kunna sake zagayowar wutar lantarki (riƙe iko ~ 10s), sannan sake haɗa shi - sake gwadawa...
action_wait_mtk: Jiran na'urar MTK... Kashe na'urar kuma haɗa USB.
action_da_stall: Na'urar ta dakatar da amsawa yayin da ake saita wakilin zazzagewa. Kashe shi gaba ɗaya, sake haɗawa, kuma sake gwadawa.
action_detected_brom: An gano na'urar (yanayin BROM) - daidaitawa wakilin zazzagewa...
action_detected_preloader: An gano na'ura (yanayin mai ɗaukar kaya) - saita wakili mai saukewa...
action_da_wait_back: Mai kunnawa ya daina amsawa yayin da yake farawa wakilin zazzagewa. Ana jira ya dawo...
action_device_connected: Na'urar da aka haɗa - tana shirya umarnin rubuta...
action_formatting: Ana tsara bayanan mai amfani da cache...
action_restart_brom: Ana sake kunna mai kunnawa zuwa yanayin BROM...
log_install_writing: Shigar da Ci gaba - rubuta hotunan firmware...
log_sparse_fmt: An gano hoton da ba a so na Android don {part}, yana juyawa cikin tsari...
err_code_sp_not_found: SP Flash Tool ba a sami
err_code_no_scatter: Babu fayil mai watsawa a cikin kunshin
err_code_missing_images: Hotunan firmware sun ɓace daga fakitin
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Tabbatar da tebur ɗin ɓangaren ya gaza bayan rubutawa
err_sp_wrong_model: Kun haɗa ƙirar ɗan wasa mara kyau. Danna maɓallin × don soke wannan shigar, sannan zaɓi software don mai kunnawa da kuka haɗa.
err_sp_timeout: Kayan aiki bai taba ganin mai kunnawa ba. Ci gaba da kunna shi kuma cire shi, sannan haɗa kebul na USB lokacin da aka sa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Mai kunnawa yayi ƙarfi da wuri. Kashe shi gaba ɗaya, sannan sake haɗa shi.
err_sp_download_fail: An katse rubutu. Duba kebul na USB da tashar jiragen ruwa da cajin baturi, sannan a sake gwadawa.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Wakilin zazzagewa ya kasa farawa. Gwada sauran hanyar walƙiya.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Ba za a iya aika wakilin zazzagewa ga mai kunnawa ba. Kashe shi kuma sake haɗawa.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Mai kunnawa ya ƙi wakilin zazzagewa (kuskure 6104). Yi amfani da Wakilin Zazzagewa wanda aka haɗe tare da SP Flash Tool, kuma duba cewa firmware ɗin ya dace da wannan mai kunnawa.
err_sp_com_port: Kayan aikin ba zai iya buɗe tashar tashar sa ba. Rufe wasu kayan aikin walƙiya kuma sake haɗawa.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Ba za a iya buɗe tashar USB COM ba (kuskure 1013). Sake kunna kwamfutarka zai saki tashar da aka kulle. Da fatan za a sake kunna kwamfutarka kuma a sake gwadawa.
err_sp_enable_dram: Kayan aikin ba zai iya fara ƙwaƙwalwar mai kunnawa ba. Yi amfani da kunshin da aka gina don wannan ainihin ƙirar.
err_sp_storage_read: Kayan aikin bai iya karanta ma'ajiyar mai kunnawa ba. Duba haɗin; na'urar na iya samun kuskuren hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Kayan aikin walƙiya bai nuna ci gaba a cikin daƙiƙa {seconds}, don haka an dakatar da wannan ƙoƙarin.
err_connection_failed_desc: An kasa kafa tsayayyen haɗi tare da mai kunnawa. Tabbatar cewa an kashe na'urar (amfani da fil don danna maɓallin sake saiti idan an buƙata), cire USB, kuma sake haɗawa lokacin da aka sa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: An katse walƙiya ko aikin rubutu ya gaza. Bincika cewa kebul na USB yana da ƙarfi a ciki kuma baturin yana da isasshen caji, sannan sake gwadawa.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Kayan aiki mai walƙiya ya nuna layi ɗaya don sakan {seconds} na ƙarshe kuma baya bayyana yana ci gaba da rubuta firmware. Wataƙila filasha ya gaza. Idan wannan shine na ƙarshe na ƙoƙari biyu tare da kowace hanya akan tsarin da zai iya komawa baya a tsakanin su, ko kuma idan MTKClient kawai yana samuwa akan wannan na'ura, sake kunna kwamfutar kuma a sake gwadawa.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient kawai yana samuwa don wannan shigarwa. Wataƙila filasha ya gaza. Da fatan za a sake kunna kwamfutar kuma a sake gwadawa.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Wannan kwamfutar kuma za ta iya shigarwa ta amfani da SP Flash Tool. Idan za ku iya, canza zuwa SP Flash Tool kuma a sake gwadawa.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Wataƙila filasha ya gaza. Da fatan za a karanta sakon da ke sama kuma sake kunna kwamfutar kafin a sake gwadawa. Idan ka danna Ok, app ɗin zai daina don sake farawa.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Fakitin firmware ya rasa fayil ɗin watsawa ko fayilolin hoto da ake buƙata. Da fatan za a sake zazzage fakitin ko zaɓi cikakken fayil ɗin firmware.
err_auth_file_unusable_title: Ba za a iya amfani da Fayil na tantancewa ba
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fayil ɗin tantancewa da kuka zaɓa ya ɓace, fanko ko ba za a iya rubuta shi ba. Zaɓi fayil mai aiki, ko share shi a cikin Saituna, sannan sake walƙiya.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ba za a iya ƙaddamar da kayan aikin walƙiya ko direbobin tsarin da ake buƙata ba. Da fatan za a duba izinin tsarin, saitin direba, ko sake shigar da aikace-aikacen.
err_driver_missing_desc: Wannan kuskuren na iya faruwa lokacin da ba a shigar da direban USB na MediaTek ba. Danna Zazzage Drivers don shigar da direban USB na MediaTek, sake kunna kwamfutarka, sannan a sake gwadawa.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayil firmware da aka adana ya ɓace. Zaɓi Zaɓi Software don sake gina fayilolin da aka ciro ko zazzage ma'ajin firmware kuma. Wannan matsala ce ta fayil ɗin gida, ba batun haɗin USB ba.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Koma zuwa Zaɓi Software don sake ginawa ko zazzage fakitin firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Zaɓi sakin firmware don sake saukewa.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Kuskuren da ba zato ba tsammani ya faru yayin shigarwa ({detail}). Kashe mai kunnawa gabaɗaya, sake haɗawa lokacin da aka sa, sannan a sake gwadawa.
flash_attempt_timeout: Ana jiran mai kunnawa… {seconds} ya rage
flash_method_confirm: An canza hanyar shigar zuwa {method}. Tabbatar cewa an cire mai kunnawa kuma an kashe shi, sannan danna Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} ba a fara shigarwa ba. Bayan an kashe mai kunnawa kuma an cire shi, za a yi amfani da {other} maimakon.
themepack_card_desc: Ya haɗa da kyawawan jigogi na al'umma, manyan bayanan baya, da kuma rubutun da aka ƙera musamman don nunin 360p.
themepack_installed_success: An shigar da Kunshin Jigo na 360p cikin nasara!
themepack_step1_title: Mataki 1: Haɗa a Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Kunna mai kunnawa ta hanyar riƙe maɓallin wuta.
2. Lokacin da Rockbox takalma, toshe kebul na USB a cikin kwamfutarka.
3. Idan aka sa akan allon mai kunnawa, tabbatar da yanayin Adana USB don haka na'urar ta bayyana azaman tuƙi.
themepack_step2_title: Mataki 2: Zaɓi Duk wani Jaka a kan Mai kunnawa
themepack_step2_desc: Saboda tsarin aiki (kamar macOS) suna ɓoye dotfiles (kamar .rockbox) ta tsohuwa, zaku iya zaɓar kowane babban fayil ko tushen tuƙi akan mai kunna ku. Za mu nemo ko ƙirƙirar ku ta atomatik.rockbox directory.
themepack_complete: An yi nasarar shigar da fakitin jigo! Yanzu zaku iya cire haɗin mai kunna ku cikin aminci kuma zaɓi jigo a Rockbox (Saituna> Saitunan Jigo).
themepack_err_not_found: Ba za a iya gano wuri ko fara .rockbox directory a kan zaɓaɓɓen drive ba. Da fatan za a tabbatar kun zaɓi babban fayil akan mai kunna ku.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Tsallake zuwa Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Mataki 1: Sake kunna mai kunnawa kuma sake haɗawa
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Cire haɗin kebul na USB.
2. Ƙaddamar da mai kunnawa kuma bar shi ya shiga cikin Rockbox.
3. Da zarar Rockbox yana aiki, sake haɗa kebul na USB, sannan danna Ci gaba.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Mataki 2: Neman player a kan ADB ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Ka'idar tana kallon haɗin ADB (har zuwa daƙiƙa 30). Idan an samo na'ura, ana canja wurin jigogi kuma an sake kunna mai kunnawa ta atomatik. In ba haka ba, tsallake gaba zuwa Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Ana jiran na'urar ADB... (har zuwa 30 seconds)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: An samo na'urar ({serial}); canja wurin jigogi...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Babu na'urar ADB da aka gano a cikin daƙiƙa 30; Ci gaba da Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Babu binary ADB da ke samuwa ga app; Ci gaba da Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Tura jigogi da rubutu akan ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Canja wurin ADB ya gaza; komawa zuwa Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Shigar ta Yanayin Ma'ajiya ta USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Kunna Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB akan mai kunnawa don ya bayyana azaman tuƙi.
2. Zaɓi kowane babban fayil akan mai kunnawa da ke ƙasa (.rockbox, Music, Jigogi, ko tushen tuƙi, babban fayil ɗin .rockbox mai ɓoye yana samuwa ta atomatik).
3. App ɗin yana haɗa jigogi 360p da fonts a ciki, suna sake rubuta fayilolin suna iri ɗaya.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Yanzu zaku iya cire haɗin mai kunnawa cikin aminci kuma zaɓi jigo a cikin Rockbox (Saituna> Saitunan Jigo).
rockbox_stage_installing: Ana shigar da Jigogi na Rockbox & Fonts...
rockbox_cleanup_deleting: Ana cire babban fayil .rockbox daga mai kunnawa...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: An shigar da sabuwar software ɗin ku, amma ba a iya cire tsohuwar babban fayil ɗin .rockbox ba. Share babban fayil .rockbox akan mai kunnawa da hannu idan kuna son farawa mai tsabta.
rockbox_stage_waiting_adb_fmt: Neman mai kunnawa ta hanyar ADB ({remaining}s)...
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: An haɗa ɗan wasa fiye da ɗaya. Cire haɗin sauran kuma bar wanda ake sakawa kawai.
rockbox_stage_pushing: An gano mai kunnawa. Ajiye jigogi & fonts...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Riƙe maɓallin tsakiya don kunna Y1 ɗinku, sake haɗa USB, kuma zaɓi Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Riƙe maɓallin wuta don kunna mai kunnawa, sake haɗa USB, kuma zaɓi Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Na'urar bata farawa? Mayar da asalin software
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Da fatan za a cire haɗin kuma kunna {model}, sannan danna Next
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Cire haɗin USB, riƙe {button} don kunna {model}, sannan danna Next.
rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Da fatan za a haɗa {model} naku ta USB
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Da fatan za a kunna yanayin ajiyar USB akan na'urar ku kuma danna Na gaba
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Da fatan za a kunna yanayin ajiya na USB akan {model}, sannan zaɓi drive ɗin da ya bayyana
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Da fatan za a zaɓi ɗan wasan da kansa ko ɗaya daga cikin manyan fayilolin da ke cikinsa
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Cire haɗin USB da wutar lantarki akan Y1 ɗinku, sannan danna Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Cire haɗin USB da wutar lantarki akan {model}, sannan danna Next.
rockbox_running_no: A'a / Ba za a fara ba
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Zaɓi 'USB Storage Mode' akan mai kunna ku.
2. Danna 'Browse Folder...' don zaɓar player da kuma shigar da themes.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Wannan ginin Rockbox yana amfani da jigogi 240 × 320, waɗanda ba a haɗa su ba. Samo jigogi kyauta don mai kunna ku daga rukunin jigon Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Idan {model} naku bai yi boot ba, cire haɗin USB, riƙe maɓallin wuta don 10s don sake saitawa, kuma kunna wuta. Ko mayar da asali software.
err_storage_full_desc: Kwamfutarka ta ƙare da wurin ajiya. Da fatan za a ba da sarari faifai a kan tuƙin ku kuma a sake gwadawa.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Wani tsohon sigar Updater har yanzu yana kan wannan kwamfutar kuma yana ɗaukar sarari diski. Cire shi yana 'yantar da wannan sarari.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Cire tsoffin aikace-aikacen Innioasis Updater da manyan fayilolin tallafi
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Ci gaba da shigar da Kayan aikin Platform na Android (ADB / Fastboot).
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Idan baku yi amfani da ADB ko Fastboot a wajen Updater CE ba, cire alamar don cirewa da sake karɓar ƙarin ajiya.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Nasarar tsaftace shigarwa na gado da kuma kwato sarari diski.

settings_run_in_background_desc: Ajiye ƙa'idar a cikin mashaya menu ko tiren tsarin bayan taga ta rufe, don haka har yanzu kuna samun sanarwar sabunta firmware na app da mai kunnawa. A kashe: rufe taga yana barin app.

donate_support_appeal_servers: Ana biyan sabar sabar, ajiya da yanki daga aljihu. Kofi yana kiyaye abubuwan zazzagewa akan layi don mai shi na gaba.
donate_support_appeal_evenings: Kowane saki a nan an gina shi da maraice da kuma karshen mako. Ƙaramar gudummawa tana sayen ƙarin lokacin.
donate_support_appeal_independent: Babu talla, babu bin diddigi kuma babu matakin biyan kuɗi. Mutanen da wannan suka taimaka ne ke samun yancin kai.
donate_support_appeal_testbench: Taimako na siyan ƴan wasan gwajin da igiyoyi da ake amfani da su don duba kowane sakin kafin kowa ya haska shi.
donate_support_appeal_bandwidth: Rumbun kayan aikin firmware yana motsa terabytes kowane wata. Taimako na biyan kuɗin bandwidth ɗin da ke isar da shi.
donate_support_appeal_monthly_costs: Kudin gudu yana zuwa kusan $200 a wata. Duk abin da za ku iya ƙarawa yana rufe gibin.
donate_support_appeal_small_change: Fam kaɗan suna tafiya mai nisa a nan: yana rufe bandwidth don ɗaruruwan shigarwa.
donate_support_appeal_long_nights: Ana gyara kwari saboda wani ya tsaya tare da samfurin ku akan benci. Gudunmawa tana ci gaba da tafiya.
donate_support_appeal_behind_the_scenes: Babu kamfani a bayan wannan, mai haɓakawa ɗaya kawai, benci na aiki da shafin bayar da gudummawa. Komai yana tafiya zuwa farashi mai gudana.
donate_support_appeal_next_feature: Kayan aikin, jagorori da ma'ajiyar bayanai duk kyauta ne. Tukwici yana tallafawa fasalin na gaba.
donate_support_appeal_kindness: Idan wannan ya yi aiki a gare ku, aika alheri a kan. Yana ba da aikin kyauta ga duk wanda ya zo na gaba.
donate_support_appeal_rescue: Wasu daga cikin 'yan wasan wannan tallafin an rubuta su a matsayin karye. Taimako yana sa sabis na ceto yana gudana.
donate_support_appeal_no_subscription: Babu biyan kuɗi, babu ranar ƙarshe, kawai shafi kamar wannan. Ba da kawai idan ya taimaka.
donate_support_appeal_one_person: Mutum ɗaya yana amsa batutuwan, ya rubuta jagororin kuma yana biyan kuɗi. Taimako na sa hakan ya dore.
donate_support_appeal_archive_forever: Firmware yana ɓacewa lokacin da runduna ta rufe. Gudunmawa suna adana kwafin da ya ceci ɗan wasan ku akan layi.
donate_support_appeal_coffee_math: Kofi ɗaya yana ɗaukar kusan bandwidth na zazzagewa. Yana kiyaye gyara na gaba cikin isarwa.
donate_family_appeal_expected: Ryan da abokin tarayya suna jiran jariri. Ba da gudummawa ga farashin tafiyar da aikin da sabon danginmu ana yabawa sosai.
donate_family_appeal_new_arrival: Akwai sabon shigowa akan hanya a gidan Ryan. Kowane gudummawa ga sabobin da dangin mu na girma yana da ma'ana mai girma.
donate_family_appeal_nursery: Ryan da abokin tarayya suna shirye don ɗansu. Idan wannan kayan aikin ya kasance mai amfani, gudummawa don farashi mai gudana da danginmu masu girma zai taimaka fiye da yadda kuka sani.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
